name: Kang Prime
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever Kang Prime enters or attacks, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card. Put two time counters on that card. If it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend. (At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last is removed, you may cast it without paying its mana cost. If it's a creature, it has haste.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever Kang Prime enters or attacks, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card. Put two time counters on that card. If it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend.

needs.what: an effect that makes a card already in exile (here the nonland card found by exile_until/reveal_until) suspended: put N time counters on it and give it suspend if it lacks it (702.62), so the engine's upkeep tick removes a counter each upkeep and offers the free cast (with haste for a creature) when the last is removed
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No keyword, op or op option in reference mentions suspend. exile_until/reveal_until can find the nonland card (reveal_until has `counters` for counters on it), but time counters alone leave an inert exiled card the upkeep tick ignores; cascade/exile_until's cast_free casts immediately rather than after two upkeeps; grant_keyword's keyword list has no suspend
